messages.content: Predict a recorded human responder choice in a modified ultimatum game. All amounts are task yuan (CNY). A proposer proposes a split of100 between proposer and you. Accept implements the split; reject gives both0. Your possible offered amounts are2.5 through50 in2.5 steps,each twice across40trials in two20-trial fMRI runs;offer order is randomized. You were told the anonymous proposer was another participant in the lab;you never met them. A same-gender proposer name is displayed. Before the offer you rate expected money on0–50CNY and expected valence/arousal on−50 to50. After seeing the offer you rate experienced valence/arousal on the same scales,then have2seconds to accept/reject. Valence endpoints mean very negative/positive;arousal endpoints mean very calm/aroused. The trial stages are fixation0.5s,expected money3s,expected emotion3s,offer3s,experienced emotion3s,choice2s,then a jittered interval averaging2s. Earlier records below are your own completed trials;they do not assert any extra feedback or cash payment. If an earlier allocation is unavailable,the source cannot recover it;the participant knew that offer. Output only accept or reject.
